summary: Verified this round's three bug fixes end-to-end on the public URL: (1) widened backend bounds + frontend clamp (no more 422 on Run Stress Test), (2) Simple generator string/char/float defaults populate on type switch, (3) AC rows are now clickable and expand with input/expected/output plus a green 'matched' note (no Explain-with-AI button for AC). All 42 backend tests pass (32 existing + 10 new). Regressions (CPP-WA, PY-AC, JAVA-AC, CE, TLE, RTE, MLE, cancel, streaming, Groq AI endpoints) all pass.

detailed_results.ac_payload: PASS - AC tests include input/expected/output and expected==output
detailed_results.frontend_clamp: PASS - entering numTests=999999, timeLimit=1, mem=2 → run STARTS (run-progress visible) and fields clamp to 5000/10/4 (no 422 toast).
detailed_results.simple_string_defaults: PASS - var-type-0=string yields var-0-charset='a-z' and var-0-len='5'; char → charset='a-z'; float → decimals='2'.
detailed_results.preview_string: PASS (alphabetic string produced in preview when line references the string var correctly)
detailed_results.ac_row_clickable: PASS - after AC run of 5/5, test-row-1 no longer disabled; clicking expands test-detail-1 showing 'Input / Expected 70 / Your Output 70 / Your output matched the reference on this test.'; explain-btn-1 is NOT rendered for AC rows.
detailed_results.regression_wa_flow: PASS - default C++ WA solution still flags WA at test #1 with diff + Explain-with-AI on the WA row (verified via existing pytest test_run_cpp_wa & test_job_cpp_wa_flow).

critical_code_review_comments: Nit (not blocking): In StressTester.onRun the clamp helper silently ignores non-numeric input and swaps in the default; consider surfacing a small hint toast so users understand why 999999 became 5000. The Settings popover already documents ranges — good.

Nit: Simple generator preview shows 'Unknown variable n' if a user changes var n to type=string while a downstream 'Random list' still uses n as its count. Not from this batch, but could benefit from a friendlier hint like 'Random list count must reference an int variable.'
context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend test module: /app/backend/tests/test_bounds_and_ac.py covers widened numTests/timeLimitMs/memLimitMb bounds and validates that AC tests include input/expected/output in /api/run/status/{jobId}. Frontend CodeMirror editors are settable via querying '[data-testid="user-editor"] .cm-content', clicking, Ctrl+A, Delete, then keyboard.type(). Language selectors: user-editor-lang / brute-editor-lang. To reliably produce all-AC runs, paste the same correct Python solution in both editors and toggle off stopOnFirstFail in Settings.
